new_destinations.name: Jinhua
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a "Jinhua" page (the prefecture) whose See section lists Shiwang Mansion, Shuanglong Cave and Jinhua Mountain; Wikipedia "Jinhua".
new_destinations.reason: Regional city and base with 4 kept spots (Shuanglong Cave, Architecture Park, Jinhua Mountain, Shiwang Mansion), meeting the four-spot bar. Rank 5: a local hub, not a national draw. Span 40 km covers the urban Wucheng/Jindong area; Lanxi, Dongyang, Yiwu and Yongkang are separate county-level cities and their spots stay standalone.

new_destinations.name: Wuyi Hot Springs
new_destinations.coordinates_source: English Wikipedia "Wuyi County, Zhejiang" article coordinates (county seat)
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikipedia "Wuyi County, Zhejiang" and Wikivoyage has a "Wuyi" page; China Daily Jinhua presents Wuyi (hot springs, ancient villages, Danxia scenery) as a two-day tour and the Wuyi Hot Springs as a tourism brand. Weak: a county name, also shared with the Fujian Wuyi Mountains, so the owner may rename it "Wuyi Hot Springs" or fold it.
new_destinations.reason: 8 kept spots clustered in one county (hot springs, Ming-Qing villages, Danxia, forest park, old town, family farm): above the four-spot bar, and no larger named region (Jinhua is 25 km away with a different draw) holds them. Rank 5.
new_destinations.rename_note: skeptic lean; owner has not chosen between rename and folding into Jinhua

note_standalone_within_40km: Jinhua centre: Liudong Mountain (17 km) and Youbu Ancient Town (31 km) are Lanxi county-level city territory, outside the urban bounds; Zhuge Bagua Village (40 km) likewise. Wuyi centre: Fangyan (35 km) is in Yongkang, a different county, outside bounds. Hengdian/Luzhai (Dongyang, 40-50 km from Jinhua) have 2 kept places, below the bar. Sibling regions: no overlap with Hangzhou/Ningbo/Wenzhou proposals (over 100 km away).
